boundary_refinement.capacity_limits: Bayesian/GRU architecture capacity remains the prespecified profiled roster; boundary wins reported as limitations, not universal optima
boundary_refinement.cnn_rule: extend selected60epoch cap to90; other architecture fixed
boundary_refinement.ridge_rule: extend selected numeric family boundary one decade; no new seed

budget.estimate_basis: pilot fits scaled by training rows/inference effort; measured H100 P256 per-origin times; two workers, I/O margin; update with core timings

robustness.policy: same validation-selected strict configurations; new contiguous fits and transforms; no test-rank selection

scoring.energy: Euclidean field energy divided by sqrt(number of target sites),1024 fixed with-replacement path pairs
scoring.failure_policy: no clipping, no fallback, preserve denominator; report complete-trajectory successful-only scores alongside failures/pending
scoring.near_tie_policy: among eligible candidates within1% of best validation loss choose lower predeclared complexity; report near-ties
